Approved by Ben 2026-11-10. Check with: node tools/narrate.mjs wrong-side-of-the-sun <code> --engine gemini --dry-run

narrator.style: Warm, quick British audiobook narrator, fond of the whole crew; plain and brisk, gently amused, natural pace with clear pauses between paragraphs

c-peregrine-blott.style: Dry, understated British man, a courier captain; says less than he means; gets more politely formal the worse things are; measured pace

c-jory-ashdown.style: Soft, slow British man, a ship's engineer; pauses before answering; laughs at his own jokes

c-sophronia-vell.style: Fast, exact young British woman, a navigator; contradicts first, checks second; tight and clipped when anxious

c-waybill.style: Formal, precise, faintly prissy ship's logkeeper; speaks in manifest language; literal and unintentionally funny; human, not robotic
